stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 exact-demand/overproduction question remained unresolved and was silently assumed as exact equality.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the waste-minimization objective, but it never asked whether the required piece counts were exact or whether overproduction was allowed, then silently assumed exact equality in its final plan.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
